{{Quote|The Fallanassi are pacifists, are they not? What ''could'' they send against us?''"<br />"''Being a pacifist isn't the same as being helpless. The Fallanassi have many defenses.|[[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Sarasu Taalon]], and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Vortex">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Vortex]]''</ref>}}
The '''Fallanassi''', also known as '''Adepts of the White Current''', was a religious order devoted to the [[White Current/Legends|White Current]], which the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] knew as [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. It was mostly an all-female group like the [[Witches of Dathomir]] and hardly ever taught men their teachings. With the White Current, the Fallanassi could do amazing things with illusions and a unique ability known as [[Force immersion]], but had no skill with manipulating the physical world through abilities such as [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]]. They taught that authority was an illusion and that everyone should serve only their own desires.<ref name="TJK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>

==History==
One of the order's first homes was on [[Lucazec/Legends|Lucazec]], but after the Fallanassi refused to swear loyalty to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], they fled ahead of his [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], their location betrayed by one of their own members, [[Isela Talsava Norand|Talsava]].

After finding a number of [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] to resettle on, the Fallanassi chose to abide on the planet [[J't'p'tan]] in the [[Koornacht Cluster/Legends|Koornacht Cluster]], inside the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] and a sanctuary of the [[H'kig]] monks. In exchange for sanctuary on the world, the Fallanassi agreed to protect their spiritual brethren by creating powerful illusions through their use of the White Current, able to convince visitors that the [[H'kig]] monastery, the [[Temple of the Infinite Spirit]], was merely a smoking ruin.

[[17 ABY/Legends|Seventeen years]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Fallanassi received two visitors: [[Akanah Norand Goss Pell|Akanah]], daughter of Talsava, and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], who sought clues about his mother and believed her to be a member of their order. Though his search proved fruitless, Skywalker persuaded [[Wialu]], leader of the Fallanassi, to create a powerful [[Mind trick/Legends#Force illusion|illusion]] of battle cruisers that helped turn the tide for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in the [[Battle of N'zoth]], thus ending the [[Yevetha]]n [[Black Fleet Crisis|crisis]]. With the Yevetha defeated, the Fallanassi left their adopted world of J't'p'tan on the [[Koqus liner]] ''[[Star Morning]]''.

The order relocated itself on [[Pydyr]], a moon of [[Almania]]. [[35 ABY/Legends|Six years]] after the [[Battle of Yuuzhan'tar|end]] of the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|war]] with the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], the order lived on under the leadership of Akanah. They were also visited by [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]], who visited sects of Force users such as the Fallanassi and the [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]] while on his six year journey following the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. Solo briefly received training from Akanah in tapping the White Current before he left to follow a call for help deep within the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] during the [[Dark Nest Crisis]].
